author: same assistant
text: R now: Cooperation, a public update and protected inside-Libya outreach are funded; outside coverage and four-inquiry detail are missing. Workshop recommendation: Extend the existing channel outside and request line-by-line updates. Broader outreach/reporting needs staff and witness-privacy safeguards; cheaper narrower outreach risks selectivity. Authority: This is workshop analysis, not observed Brazilian endorsement of R or an established future vote.
